canonical_source.behavior: ToggleSortAsync flips the descending flag, resets the current page to 1, and raises SortChanged with the new direction; rows are ordered case-insensitively through SortKeySelector.

laravel_adaptation.sort_key_mapping: Email History maps SortKeySelector to created_at with delivery_id fallback over the authoritative rows returned for the current tenant page.
semantics: toggle the descending flag exactly once per activation
reset the consumer page to 1 on every sort activation
render ascending/descending accessible state and matching directional icon
sort a copied row collection without mutating authoritative query data
perform no persistence, WordPress, queue, cache, provider, or secret mutation
